_comment: Interface-level design-of-record. pinmap is the binding GPIO contract (spec 8.1). nets lists only the named interface nets and module/IC-level power consumers; passive interconnects (gate-drive R/C, dividers, decoupling) are realized and ERC-checked in Tasks 4-6 and intentionally NOT enumerated here. Reference designators: A1=ESP32 DevKitV1, U2=5V buck, U3=3V3 LDO, U4=12V supply, J1=24V input, J3=MAX31855 module header, J4=OLED module header, SW1=rotary encoder (Device:RotaryEncoder_Switch, pins A/B/C/S1/S2), SW2=start push button (Switch:SW_Push), D1=status LED, Q1=heater MOSFET, HP1=hotplate heater.
